name: Echigo-Yuzawa Station
desc: Shinkansen gateway from Tokyo to the Yuzawa ski area. Sake tasting is available inside the station (Ponshukan).

name: GALA Yuzawa Snow Resort
desc: Ski resort with its own Shinkansen station on the Joetsu line in winter, so it works as a day trip from Tokyo.

name: Naeba Ski Resort
desc: Large resort in the Yuzawa area, popular with international visitors.

name: Akakura Onsen (Myoko Kogen)
desc: Hot spring village at the base of Myoko Kogen, a snowy area known for deep powder.

name: Joetsumyoko Station
desc: Hokuriku Shinkansen stop and the usual starting point for the Myoko area.

name: Hakkaisan Brewery
desc: Well-known sake brewery in Minamiuonuma, close to the Yuzawa ski area. Check the brewery's site for tour and tasting availability.
